title: Beginner Scarf
description: A long, repetitive project that makes row tracking genuinely useful.
expectationText: A longer repeat project where the app helps you stay on track without recounting every row from scratch.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Half double crochet in the third chain from the hook and each chain across.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 40
steps.instruction: Chain 2, turn, and work half double crochet across each row.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off, weave in ends, and block lightly if needed.
